{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Ensure revenue is numeric
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric values in revenue
non_numeric_revenue = sales_df[~pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce').notna()]

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue for these orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Check if any rows were found
count_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)

non_numeric_revenue.shape, mean_revenue, count_loyal_completed"}
